# REQ: LANG-781 LANG-782 LANG-783 LANG-784
#!/bin/csh
set name = "world"
set count = 3
setenv EDITOR vim

# Loop over the names.
foreach n (alice bob)
    if ($n == "bob") then
        echo "Hello, $n"
    else
        echo 'single $not'
    endif
end

while ($count > 0)
    @ count--
end
alias ll 'ls -l'
set files = `ls *.txt`
exit 0
